quote_json: "scope of a local variable or constant"

quote_json: "return statement to appear in an iterator block"

quote_json: "iterator block to contain an unsafe context"

requirement: Executing a statement list transfers control to its first statement.

quote_json: "control is transferred to the next statement"

quote_json: "first statement and the statement list itself is reachable"

quote_json: "end point of the preceding statement is reachable"
requirement: A statement in a list is reachable when the preceding statement's end point is reachable.

quote_json: "label is referenced by a reachable goto statement"

quote_json: "last statement in the list is reachable"

A semicolon alone is an empty_statement.
Executing an empty statement transfers control to its end point.
An empty statement's end point is reachable when the statement is reachable.
A labeled_statement consists of an identifier, a colon, and a statement.
A block may contain labeled statements.
A labeled statement cannot directly be an embedded statement.

quote_json: "declares a label with the name given by the identifier"

notes: Normal-flow reachability remains applicable; see 13.10.4 and 13.11.

requirement: A local_variable_declaration introduces one or more local variables.

A declaration statement cannot directly occupy an embedded_statement position.
A declaration statement introduces its declared names into the nearest enclosing declaration space.
A local_variable_declaration may be implicitly typed.
A local_variable_declaration may be explicitly typed.
A local_variable_declaration may be a ref local declaration.

Each local-variable declarator defines the introduced variable's name.
Each local-variable declarator defines its variable's initial value when an initializer is present.

requirement: Multiple local declarators, including their initializing expressions, are processed from left to right.
A local variable's value may be obtained by a simple_name expression.

A local variable introduced by a local_variable_declaration is initially unassigned.

A variable declared in a for_initializer is in scope throughout that initializer, condition, iterator, and embedded statement.

quote_json: "outermost block of the semantically equivalent expansion"

Other local_variable_declaration variables have their declaring block as scope.
A local variable cannot be referenced by name before its declarator.

quote_json: "within any initializing expression within its declarator"

quote_json: "another local variable, local function or constant with the same name"
requirement: Another local variable with the same name cannot be declared within a local variable's scope.

quote_json: "another local variable, local function or constant with the same name"
requirement: A local function with the same name cannot be declared within a local variable's scope.

quote_json: "another local variable, local function or constant with the same name"

An implicitly typed local declaration introduces exactly one local variable named by its identifier.
An implicitly typed local's expression or variable_reference must have a compile-time type.

The implicitly typed ref form declares a ref variable of type ref T where T is the initializing reference's compile-time type.
The implicitly typed ref form initially refers to the variable identified by its variable_reference.
An explicitly typed local declaration consists of a type followed by explicitly typed declarators.
Explicitly typed local declarators form a nonempty comma-separated list.
An explicitly typed local declarator consists of an identifier with an optional equals sign and local_variable_initializer.
A local_variable_initializer may be an expression.
A local_variable_initializer may be an array_initializer.

notes: See 12.21.2 and 17.7; do not duplicate their conversion rules.

quote_json: "assigned as the initial value of the variable"

A ref local declaration consists of ref_kind, a type, and ref local declarators.
Ref local declarators form a nonempty comma-separated list.
A ref local declarator consists of an identifier, equals, ref, and a variable_reference.
A ref local's initializing variable_reference must have the declared type.

quote_json: "same requirements as for a ref assignment"
requirement: A ref local's initializing reference must satisfy the ref-assignment requirements.

quote_json: "references to variables that are treated as read-only"
requirement: A ref readonly local is a reference whose variable is treated as read-only.
A ref local declared with ref must refer to a writable variable.
An async method cannot declare a ref local variable.
An iterator cannot declare a ref local variable.

quote_json: "a variable of a ref struct type"
requirement: An async method cannot declare a variable of a ref struct type.

quote_json: "a variable of a ref struct type"
requirement: An iterator cannot declare a variable of a ref struct type.
A local constant declaration consists of const, a type, and constant_declarators.
Local constant declarators form a nonempty comma-separated list.
A local constant declarator consists of its name, equals, and a constant_expression.
Each constant in a local constant declaration has the declaration's specified type.
Each local constant declarator's constant_expression supplies that constant's value.

quote_json: "same rules as those of a constant member declaration"
requirement: A local constant's type must satisfy the constant-member type rules.

quote_json: "same rules as those of a constant member declaration"
requirement: A local constant's constant_expression must satisfy the constant-member expression rules.
A local constant's value may be obtained by a simple_name expression.
A local constant's scope is the block containing its declaration.
A local constant cannot be referenced before the end of its constant_declarator.

quote_json: "another local variable, local function or constant with the same name"
requirement: A local variable with the same name cannot be declared within a local constant's scope.

quote_json: "another local variable, local function or constant with the same name"
requirement: A local function with the same name cannot be declared within a local constant's scope.

quote_json: "another local variable, local function or constant with the same name"
requirement: Another local constant with the same name cannot be declared within a local constant's scope.

quote_json: "equivalent to multiple declarations of single constants"
requirement: A declaration of multiple local constants is equivalent to individual declarations of those constants with the same type.
A non-ref local function consists of zero or more local modifiers, a return_type, a header, and a local_function_body.
A ref-returning local function consists of zero or more ref-local modifiers, ref_kind, ref_return_type, a header, and a ref body.
A nongeneric local function header consists of an identifier and a parenthesized optional formal parameter list.
A generic local function header includes a type parameter list, an optional formal parameter list, and zero or more type-parameter constraint clauses.
A ref_local_function_modifier is a local_function_modifier.
Async is a local_function_modifier.
An unsafe_modifier is a ref_local_function_modifier.
A non-ref local function body may be a block.
A non-ref local function body may be an arrow followed by a null-conditional invocation expression and a semicolon.
A non-ref local function body may be an arrow followed by an expression and a semicolon.
A ref local function body may be a block.
A ref local function body may be an arrow, ref, a variable_reference, and a semicolon.
When both local_function_body expression alternatives match, the null_conditional_invocation_expression alternative is selected.

requirement: Local function grammar elements use method-declaration semantics in the local-function context except where this subclause states otherwise.
notes: See 15.6.1; do not copy method rules.

quote_json: "must be unique in its declared block scope"
requirement: A local function identifier must be unique in its block scope including enclosing local-variable declaration spaces.
notes: Consequently local function overloads are forbidden by this predicate.

quote_json: "may include one async (\u00a715.15) modifier and one unsafe (\u00a723.1) modifier"
requirement: A local function declaration may include an async modifier and an unsafe modifier together.
A local function declaration cannot repeat its async modifier.
A local function declaration cannot repeat its unsafe modifier.

quote_json: "return type shall be void or a \u00abTaskType\u00bb type"
requirement: An async local function's return type must be void or a TaskType.

quote_json: "unsafe modifier uses the containing lexical scope"
requirement: An unsafe local function modifier uses the containing lexical scope.

quote_json: "async modifier does not use the containing lexical scope"
requirement: An async local function modifier does not use the containing lexical scope.
A local function's type parameter list cannot contain attributes.
A local function's formal parameter list cannot contain attributes.
A local function is declared at block scope.

quote_json: "may capture variables from the enclosing scopes"
requirement: A local function may capture variables from enclosing scopes.
Every variable read through capture by a local function must be definitely assigned before each call to that function.

quote_json: "determine which variables are definitely assigned on return"
requirement: The compiler determines which variables are definitely assigned on return from a local function.

quote_json: "body of a local function to access this"
requirement: A local function body cannot access a struct-typed this either explicitly or implicitly.

quote_json: "does not affect whether member lookup results in a member of the struct"
requirement: The local-function prohibition on struct this access does not change member lookup results.

quote_json: "goto statement, a break statement, or a continue statement"
requirement: A goto in a local function body cannot target a location outside that body.

quote_json: "goto statement, a break statement, or a continue statement"
requirement: A break in a local function body cannot target a location outside that body.

quote_json: "goto statement, a break statement, or a continue statement"
requirement: A continue in a local function body cannot target a location outside that body.

quote_json: "called from a lexical point prior to its declaration"
requirement: A local function may be called before its declaration in lexical order.

quote_json: "declared lexically prior to the declaration of a variable used"
requirement: A local function cannot be declared before the declaration of a variable used by that function.

quote_json: "parameter, type parameter or local variable with the same name"
requirement: A local function parameter cannot reuse a name declared in an enclosing local-variable declaration space.

quote_json: "parameter, type parameter or local variable with the same name"
requirement: A local function type parameter cannot reuse a name declared in an enclosing local-variable declaration space.

quote_json: "parameter, type parameter or local variable with the same name"
requirement: A local variable in a local function cannot reuse a name declared in an enclosing local-variable declaration space.
A local function body is always reachable.

quote_json: "beginning point of the local function declaration is reachable"
requirement: A local function declaration's end point is reachable when its beginning point is reachable.
A local function call with a dynamic argument resolves which function to call at compile time.
An expression statement evaluates its contained expression.

quote_json: "value computed by the expression, if any, is discarded"
requirement: An expression statement discards any value computed by its expression.
An expression_statement is a statement_expression followed by a semicolon.
A null_conditional_invocation_expression is a statement_expression.
An invocation_expression is a statement_expression.
An object_creation_expression is a statement_expression.
An assignment is a statement_expression.
A post_increment_expression is a statement_expression.
A post_decrement_expression is a statement_expression.
A pre_increment_expression is a statement_expression.
A pre_decrement_expression is a statement_expression.
An await_expression is a statement_expression.

requirement: An expression outside the statement_expression grammar cannot be used directly as an expression statement.

quote_json: "then transfers control to the end point"
requirement: After its expression is evaluated, an expression statement transfers control to its end point.
An expression statement's end point is reachable when the statement is reachable.

quote_json: "based on the value of some expression"
requirement: A selection statement chooses one of its possible statements for execution according to an expression's value.
An if_statement is a selection_statement.
A switch_statement is a selection_statement.
An if statement may consist of if, a parenthesized boolean_expression, and an embedded statement.
An if statement may add else and a second embedded statement to the if form.
An else associates with the lexically nearest preceding if allowed by the syntax.
Executing an if statement first evaluates its boolean_expression.

quote_json: "control is transferred to the first embedded statement"
requirement: A true if condition transfers control to the first embedded statement.
Reaching the first embedded statement's end point transfers control to the if statement's end point.

quote_json: "control is transferred to the second embedded statement"
requirement: A false if condition with an else transfers control to the second embedded statement.
Reaching the second embedded statement's end point transfers control to the if statement's end point.
A false if condition without an else transfers control to the if statement's end point.

quote_json: "does not have the constant value false"
requirement: The first if branch is reachable when the if statement is reachable and its condition is not constant false.

quote_json: "does not have the constant value true"
requirement: The second if branch is reachable when the if statement is reachable and its condition is not constant true.

quote_json: "at least one of its embedded statements is reachable"
requirement: An if statement's end point is reachable when an embedded statement's end point is reachable.

quote_json: "if statement with no else part is reachable"
requirement: An if statement without else also has a reachable end point when the statement is reachable and its condition is not constant true.
A switch_statement consists of switch, a parenthesized expression, and a switch_block.
A switch_block consists of zero or more switch_sections enclosed in braces.
A switch_section consists of one or more switch_labels followed by a statement_list.
A case switch_label consists of case, a pattern, an optional case_guard, and a colon.
A default switch_label consists of default followed by a colon.
A case_guard consists of when followed by an expression.

quote_json: "its expression shall be implicitly convertible to"
requirement: A case_guard expression shall be implicitly convertible to bool.

quote_json: "that expression is evaluated as an additional condition"
requirement: A present case_guard expression is evaluated as an additional condition for its case to be satisfied.
A switch expression of type sbyte, byte, short, ushort, int, uint, long, ulong, char, bool, string, an enum type, or a corresponding nullable value type has that same governing type.

quote_json: "if exactly one user-defined implicit conversion exists"
requirement: Otherwise, exactly one user-defined implicit conversion to sbyte, byte, short, ushort, int, uint, long, ulong, char, string, or a corresponding nullable value type makes that converted type the switch governing type.
notes: This conversion branch excludes bool and enum types even though the preceding direct-type branch includes them.

quote_json: "the governing type of the switch statement is the type"
requirement: Otherwise, the switch expression's own type is the governing type.

quote_json: "It is an error if no such type exists."
requirement: A switch expression shall have a type from which its governing type can be established.
A switch statement shall not contain more than one default label.
Each switch-label pattern shall be applicable to the input expression's type.
notes: Applicability is defined in 11.2.1; preserve the source's input-expression wording.

quote_json: "the pattern of any switch label is subsumed"
requirement: A switch-label pattern shall not be subsumed by the set of earlier label patterns whose guards are absent or constant true.
Executing a switch statement first evaluates its switch expression.
The evaluated switch expression is converted to the governing type before label selection.
Control transfers to the statement list following the lexically first case label whose pattern matches the converted switch value and whose guard is absent or evaluates to true.
notes: Pattern matching is defined in clause 11; the delimited note about matching order yields no separate rule.

quote_json: "Otherwise, if a default label is present"
requirement: When no case is satisfied and a default label exists, control transfers to the statement list following the default label.

quote_json: "control is transferred to the end point"
requirement: When no case is satisfied and no default label exists, control transfers to the switch statement's end point.

quote_json: "end point of the statement list of a switch section is reachable"
requirement: A switch section's statement-list end point shall not be reachable.

quote_json: "the value null is permitted as a case label constant"
requirement: A switch with governing type string permits null as a case-label constant.
notes: This sentence follows end note within a mixed source block; the preceding delimited note is informative.

quote_json: "the value null is permitted as a case label constant"
requirement: A switch with a nullable value governing type permits null as a case-label constant.
notes: This sentence follows end note within a mixed source block; the preceding delimited note is informative.

requirement: A switch section's statement_list may contain declaration statements.

quote_json: "scope of a local variable or constant"
requirement: A local variable declared in a switch block has the switch block as its scope.

quote_json: "scope of a local variable or constant"
requirement: A constant declared in a switch block has the switch block as its scope.

quote_json: "the label is a case whose pattern would match"
requirement: With a constant switch expression, a case label is reachable if its pattern would match that value and its guard is absent or is not constant false.
With a constant switch expression, a default label is reachable if no case pattern would match that value with an absent or constant-true guard.

quote_json: "the label is a case without a guard"
requirement: With a nonconstant switch expression, a case label is reachable if its guard is absent or is not constant false.
With a nonconstant switch expression, a default label is reachable if the set of case patterns with absent or constant-true guards is not exhaustive for the governing type.

quote_json: "does not contain a pattern that would match the value null"
requirement: With a nonconstant switch expression and a nullable governing type, a default label is reachable if no case pattern with an absent or constant-true guard would match null.
A switch label referenced by a reachable goto case statement is reachable.
A switch label referenced by a reachable goto default statement is reachable.
A switch section's statement list is reachable if the switch statement is reachable and the section contains a reachable switch label.

quote_json: "reachable break statement that exits the switch statement"
requirement: A reachable switch statement has a reachable end point if it contains a reachable break that exits it.
A reachable switch statement with no default and a nonconstant expression has a reachable end point if its case patterns with absent or constant-true guards are not exhaustive for the governing type.
A reachable switch statement with no default and a nonconstant nullable expression has a reachable end point if no case pattern with an absent or constant-true guard would match null.
A reachable switch statement with no default and a constant expression has a reachable end point if no case label with an absent or constant-true guard would match that value.
An iteration statement repeatedly executes its embedded statement.
A while_statement is an iteration_statement.
A do_statement is an iteration_statement.
A for_statement is an iteration_statement.
A foreach_statement is an iteration_statement.
A while_statement consists of while, a parenthesized boolean_expression, and an embedded_statement.
Executing a while statement first evaluates its Boolean condition.
A true while condition transfers control to the embedded statement.

quote_json: "control is transferred to the beginning of the while statement"
requirement: Reaching the while body end point, including through continue, transfers control to the beginning of the while statement to reevaluate its condition.
A false while condition transfers control to the while statement's end point.
A while body may use break to transfer control to the while statement's end point.
notes: Break targeting and finally unwinding are defined in 13.10.2.

requirement: A while body may use continue to transfer control to the body's end point and perform another iteration.
notes: Continue targeting and finally unwinding are defined in 13.10.3.

quote_json: "Boolean expression does not have the constant value false"
requirement: The while body is reachable if the while statement is reachable and its condition is not constant false.
A while statement's end point is reachable if it contains a reachable break that exits it.

quote_json: "does not have the constant value true"
requirement: A while statement's end point is reachable if the statement is reachable and its condition is not constant true.
A do_statement consists of do, an embedded_statement, while, a parenthesized boolean_expression, and a semicolon.

quote_json: "Control is transferred to the embedded statement."
requirement: Executing a do statement first transfers control to its embedded statement.
Reaching the do body's end point, including through continue, evaluates the Boolean condition.

quote_json: "control is transferred to the beginning of the do statement"
requirement: A true do condition transfers control to the beginning of the do statement to execute its body again.

quote_json: "control is transferred to the end point of the do statement"
requirement: A false do condition transfers control to the do statement's end point.
A do body may use break to transfer control to the do statement's end point.
notes: Break targeting and finally unwinding are defined in 13.10.2.

requirement: A do body may use continue to transfer control to the body's end point and evaluate the condition for another iteration.
notes: Continue targeting and finally unwinding are defined in 13.10.3.

requirement: The do body is reachable if the do statement is reachable.
A do statement's end point is reachable if it contains a reachable break that exits it.

quote_json: "end point of the embedded statement is reachable"
requirement: A do statement's end point is reachable if its body end point is reachable and its condition is not constant true.
A for_statement consists of for, a parenthesized initializer, condition, and iterator separated by semicolons, each independently optional, followed by an embedded_statement.
A for_initializer may be a local_variable_declaration.

requirement: A for_initializer may be a statement_expression_list.
A for_condition is a boolean_expression.
A present for_condition shall satisfy the boolean_expression requirements.
notes: The form is E13-9-4-form-for-condition; Boolean-expression validity is defined in 12.24.

requirement: A for_iterator is a statement_expression_list.
A statement_expression_list consists of one or more statement_expressions separated by commas.

quote_json: "scope of a local variable declared by a for_initializer"
requirement: A variable declared in a for_initializer has a scope covering the for_initializer, for_condition, for_iterator, and embedded_statement.

quote_json: "executed in the order they are written"
requirement: A present for_initializer executes its variable initializers or statement expressions in written order before evaluating the condition.
The for_initializer executes only once per execution of the for statement.

quote_json: "If a for_condition is present, it is evaluated."
requirement: A present for_condition is evaluated after initialization and at the start of each subsequent iteration.
An absent for_condition transfers control to the for body.
A true for_condition transfers control to the for body.

quote_json: "expressions of the for_iterator, if any, are evaluated in sequence"
requirement: Reaching the for body's end point, including through continue, evaluates any for_iterator expressions in sequence.

quote_json: "another iteration is performed, starting with evaluation of the for_condition"
requirement: After any for_iterator evaluation, the for statement performs another iteration beginning with the condition-evaluation step.
A present for_condition that evaluates to false transfers control to the for statement's end point.
A for body may use break to transfer control to the for statement's end point.
notes: Break targeting and finally unwinding are defined in 13.10.2.

requirement: A for body may use continue to reach the body's end point and proceed with the iterator and next condition evaluation.
notes: Continue targeting and finally unwinding are defined in 13.10.3.

requirement: The for body is reachable if the for statement is reachable and no for_condition is present.

quote_json: "does not have the constant value false"
requirement: The for body is reachable if the for statement is reachable and its present for_condition is not constant false.

quote_json: "exception is propagated to the next enclosing try statement"
requirement: An exception thrown in a finally and not caught within that same finally propagates to the next enclosing try statement.
An exception escaping a finally replaces and loses any exception already being propagated.
A try block is reachable if its try statement is reachable.
A catch block is reachable if its try statement is reachable.
A finally block is reachable if its try statement is reachable.

quote_json: "end point of the try block is reachable or"
requirement: A try statement's end point is reachable if the try or a catch block has a reachable end point and any present finally also has a reachable end point.
A checked_statement consists of checked followed by a block.
An unchecked_statement consists of unchecked followed by a block.

quote_json: "all expressions in the block to be evaluated in a checked context"
requirement: A checked statement evaluates all expressions in its block in a checked overflow-checking context, equivalent to the checked operator applied to a block.
notes: Overflow arithmetic and conversion semantics are defined in 12.8.19.

quote_json: "all expressions in the block to be evaluated in an unchecked context"
requirement: An unchecked statement evaluates all expressions in its block in an unchecked overflow-checking context, equivalent to the unchecked operator applied to a block.
notes: Overflow arithmetic and conversion semantics are defined in 12.8.19.

requirement: A lock_statement consists of lock, a parenthesized expression, and an embedded_statement.
A lock expression shall have a type known to be a reference, so an expression of a value type is a compile-time error.

quote_json: "No implicit boxing conversion (\u00a710.2.9) is ever performed"
requirement: A lock statement never implicitly boxes its expression.
Lock behaves as if its acquisition flag is initialized to false before entering the try.
Lock obtains the object's mutual-exclusion lock through Monitor.Enter inside the try, passing the acquisition flag by reference.
When Monitor.Enter completes normally, lock executes its embedded statement while holding the object's lock.
Lock's finally calls Monitor.Exit on the same object only if the acquisition flag indicates that the lock was taken.
The lock object expression is evaluated exactly once for both acquisition and release.

quote_json: "same execution thread can also obtain and release the lock"
requirement: Code on a thread already holding an object's lock may obtain and release that lock again.

quote_json: "other threads is blocked from obtaining the lock"
requirement: While an object's mutual-exclusion lock is held, other threads are blocked from obtaining it until it is released.
A using_statement consists of using, a parenthesized resource_acquisition, and an embedded_statement.
A using resource_acquisition may be a local_variable_declaration.
notes: Local variable declarations are defined in 13.6.2.

requirement: A using resource_acquisition may be an expression.

quote_json: "A resource is a class or struct"
requirement: A using resource is a class or struct implementing System.IDisposable.

quote_json: "includes a single parameterless method named Dispose"
requirement: The resource interface System.IDisposable includes a single parameterless method named Dispose.

quote_json: "can call Dispose to indicate that the resource is no longer needed"
requirement: Code using a resource may call Dispose to signal that the resource is no longer needed.

quote_json: "shall be either dynamic or a type"
requirement: A using resource declaration may have type dynamic.

quote_json: "a type that can be implicitly converted to System.IDisposable"
requirement: A using resource declaration whose type is not dynamic shall have a type implicitly convertible to System.IDisposable.

quote_json: "this expression shall be implicitly convertible to System.IDisposable"
requirement: A using resource expression shall be implicitly convertible to System.IDisposable.

quote_json: "Local variables declared in a resource_acquisition are read-only"
requirement: A local variable declared by using resource acquisition is read-only.
notes: The body mutation errors are enumerated separately; this paragraph's read-only classification is unqualified.

requirement: Every local variable declared by using resource acquisition shall have an initializer.

quote_json: "attempts to modify these local variables (via assignment"
requirement: The using body shall not assign to a declared resource variable.
The using body shall not apply ++ to a declared resource variable.
The using body shall not apply -- to a declared resource variable.
The using body shall not take the address of a declared resource variable.

quote_json: "pass them as ref or out parameters"
requirement: The using body shall not pass a declared resource variable as a ref argument.

quote_json: "pass them as ref or out parameters"
requirement: The using body shall not pass a declared resource variable as an out argument.

quote_json: "translated into three parts: acquisition, usage, and disposal"
requirement: Using acquires and initializes its resources before entering the try for the embedded statement.

quote_json: "Usage of the resource is implicitly enclosed in a try statement"
requirement: Using executes the embedded statement inside a try whose finally disposes of the resource.
Acquiring a null using resource does not cause a Dispose call.
Acquiring a null using resource does not itself cause an exception.

quote_json: "dynamically converted through an implicit dynamic conversion"
requirement: A dynamic using resource is implicitly dynamically converted to IDisposable during acquisition before its usage and disposal.
For a nonnullable value resource type or a type parameter with a value-type constraint, using finally invokes Dispose through IDisposable on the resource.
notes: Type parameter constraints are defined in 15.2.5.

quote_json: "cast of resource to System.IDisposable shall not cause boxing to occur"
requirement: The using disposal cast to IDisposable for a nonnullable value type or value-constrained type parameter shall not box the resource.
For a dynamic resource type, using finally calls Dispose on the previously converted IDisposable value only when that value is nonnull.
For resource types outside the value-constrained and dynamic expansion branches, using finally casts the resource to IDisposable to obtain d.
For resource types outside the value-constrained and dynamic expansion branches, using finally calls d.Dispose only when the converted IDisposable value d is nonnull.

quote_json: "d variable is inaccessible in, and invisible to, the embedded statement"
requirement: The generated using disposal variable d is inaccessible and invisible to the embedded statement.

quote_json: "as long as the behavior is consistent with the above expansion"
requirement: An implementation may implement using differently from its specified expansion if it preserves the expansion's behavior.

quote_json: "ResourceType is implicitly the compile-time type of the expression"
requirement: Expression-form using applies the same disposal expansions with ResourceType equal to the expression's compile-time type when it has one.

quote_json: "interface IDisposable itself is used as the ResourceType"
requirement: Expression-form using with no compile-time expression type applies the same disposal expansions with ResourceType IDisposable.

quote_json: "resource variable is inaccessible in, and invisible to, the embedded statement"
requirement: The generated resource variable in expression-form using is inaccessible and invisible to the embedded statement.

quote_json: "possible to acquire multiple resources of a given type"
requirement: Declaration-form using may acquire multiple resources of a single given type.
A multiple-resource using is equivalent to one nested using for each declaration in order, with the first resource's using outermost.
A multiple-resource using acquires resources in declaration order.
A multiple-resource using disposes acquired resources in reverse declaration order as the nested using statements unwind.
notes: The equivalence also preserves disposal of already acquired resources if a later acquisition fails.

requirement: A yield return statement consists of yield return, an expression, and a semicolon.
A yield break statement consists of yield break followed by a semicolon.

quote_json: "special meaning only when used immediately before a return or break keyword"
requirement: The contextual keyword yield has its special meaning only immediately before return or break.
Either form of yield shall appear inside a method_body, operator_body, or accessor_body.
Either form of yield shall not appear inside an anonymous function.

quote_json: "in the finally clause of a try statement"
requirement: Either form of yield shall not appear in a try statement's finally clause.

quote_json: "anywhere in a try statement that contains any catch_clauses"
requirement: Yield return shall not appear anywhere in a try statement that has catch clauses.
A yield return expression's type shall have an implicit conversion to the iterator's yield type.
notes: Implicit conversion rules are in 10.2; yield type is defined in 15.14.4.

quote_json: "The expression given in the statement is evaluated"
requirement: Yield return first evaluates its expression.
Yield return implicitly converts its expression value to the iterator's yield type.

quote_json: "assigned to the Current property of the enumerator object"
requirement: Yield return assigns the converted value to the enumerator object's Current property.
notes: Enumerator and enumerable iterator objects are described in 15.14.5 and 15.14.6.

quote_json: "Execution of the iterator block is suspended."
requirement: Yield return suspends execution of the iterator block.

quote_json: "associated finally blocks are not executed at this time"
requirement: Yield return inside try blocks does not execute their associated finally blocks when it suspends the iterator.

quote_json: "MoveNext method of the enumerator object returns true"
requirement: After yield return suspends the iterator, the enumerator's MoveNext returns true to its caller to indicate advancement.

quote_json: "resumes execution of the iterator block from where it was last suspended"
requirement: The next call to the enumerator's MoveNext resumes the iterator block from its last suspension point.

quote_json: "finally block of the innermost try statement"
requirement: A yield break enclosed in try blocks with finally clauses executes their finally blocks from innermost to outermost, proceeding only when each reaches its end point.
Yield break signals the end of the iterator's iteration.
notes: Enumerator and enumerable completion details belong to 15.14.5 and 15.14.6; no separate MoveNext return-value rule is stated here for yield break.

quote_json: "Control is returned to the caller of the iterator block."
requirement: After finally unwinding, yield break returns control to the iterator block's caller, which is the enumerator's MoveNext or Dispose method.

quote_json: "end point of a yield break statement is never reachable"
requirement: A yield break statement's end point is never reachable.
